before. My lap
times are becoming more

text_block_list.text:
Looks like my theory was correct...
Okay, one
more lap!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
...Hey, I changed my mind. Let's do some
extra
training.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Give me something that'll exhaust me to
my
bones. Otherwise...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: The fire in my chest just won't go out!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: We can put it out tomorrow.

text_block_list.text: No. It has to be now, or there's no point.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I tell her it's more efficient to train after
a rest
than to train while her body is
already tired.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Efficient? You sound like my sister.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Tch, fine. But that means I want
something extra
challenging tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I continue to add on extra training until
Narita
Brian is satisfied.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
